response.changelog:
**WARNING:** This is a config breaking and save breaking update.
- Do not update this mod in existing saves.
- If you are using a modpack that contains this mod, do not manually update this mod - wait for the modpack to update.

## Simply Swords changelog:

Additions & Reworks:
- Added per-player regional loot pity system
- Added weapon awakening system
- Added Runic Forge block
- Added weapon implicits
- Reworked Hiveheart ability
- Reworked Soulkeeper ability
- Reworked Icewhisper ability
- Reworked Arcanethyst ability
- Reworked Brimstone Claymore ability
- Reworked Stormbringer ability
- Reworked Livyatan ability
- Reworked Thunderbrand ability
- Reworked Molten Edge ability
- Reworked Storm's Edge ability
- Reworked The Watcher ability
- Reworked Twisted Blade ability
- Reworked Mjolnir ability
- Reworked Caelestis ability
- Reworked SoulPyre ability
- Reworked Hearthflame ability
- Reworked Longsword of the Plague ability
- Reworked Magiblade ability
- Reworked Star's Edge ability
- Reworked Waxweaver ability
- Reworked Bramblethorn ability
- Reworked Shadowsting ability
- Reworked Enigma ability
- Reworked Soulstealer ability
- Reworked Immolation visuals
- Reworked Emberlash ability visuals
- Reworked Whisperwind ability visuals
- Reworked Flamewind ability visuals
- Reworked Frostfall ability visuals
- Reworked Harbinger/Sunbringer ability visuals
- Reworked Soulrender ability visuals
- Added new Nether power 'Wolf Pack'
- Added new Nether power 'Verdant Trail'
- Added new Nether power 'Necromantic Arsenal'
- Added new Nether power 'Goat Stampede'
- Added new Nether power 'Wing Buffet'
- Added new Nether power 'Dragon Maw'
- Added new Runic power 'Stormlash'
- Added new Runic power 'Dancing Blades'
- Added new Runic power 'Faultline'
- Added new Runic power 'Banehead Swarm'
- Added new Runic power 'Runic Slash'
- Added new Runic power 'Evocation'
- Added new Runic power 'Sniffer Slam'
- Added new unique glaive 'Stormscale'
- Added new unique cutlass 'Bloodwake'
- Added new unique claymore 'The Devourer'
- Added new unique claymore 'Riftmane'
- Added new unique claymore 'Dawnquiver'
- Added new unique variant 'Ionbound Stormscale'
- Added new unique variant 'Wraithmaw'
- Added new unique variant 'Gloampiercer'
- Added new unique variant 'Shadowstalker'
- Added new unique variant 'Dreadwhisper'

Compatibility:
- Added Apotheosis compatibility (via Simply Tooltips)
- Improved Spell Engine compatibility (better spell hotbar integration)
- Improved Spell Power API support (unique weapons now have spell power attributes)
- Added Iron's Spells 'n Spellbooks compatibility
-- Support for true magic damage/resistances
-- Support for cooldown reduction
-- Support for mana costs
-- Support for magic school spell scaling


Misc:
- Added consistent cooldown tooltip information for all unique weapons
- Added developer documentation
- Added OP command to grant runefused gems, netherfused gems, and runic weapons with the chosen power
- Added OP command to summon mobs with unique weapons and gems
- Added OP command for loot droprate testing
- Added OP command for loot pity testing
- Removed Patchouli support
- The Wither no longer drops uniques by default
- Reduced unique droprates for the End Dragon
- Updated some weapon tooltip themes
- All unique abilities and gem powers now scale with attack attribute (rather than configurable flat value). Scaling multipliers are configurable
- Removed Lichblade and Dormant Relic crafting recipes in favour of Runic Forge based upgrade paths
- Decoupled ability and gem logic from the player, allowing any living entity to use weapon abilities and gem powers (see the new mod 'Simply Entity Equipment')
- Unique weapon abilities can now be assigned a keybinding
- Reduce damage scaling across the board by about 20%
- Unique weapons are now guaranteed Netherfused and Runefused sockets
- Gems in sockets can now be freely swapped. Placing a gem into a socket that already contains a gem, replaces the gem in that socket and refunds the old one to the player's inventory.

Bugfixes:
- Fixed an issue that resulted in thrown weapons having a red tint when shaders were enabled
- Fixed an issue that resulted in Wickpiercer's Frenzy stacks being consumed on thrown weapon hits
- Fixed a bug that allowed some weapon/gem effects to target and affect players in creative mode
- Fixed #285 Star's edge's model now references the correct texture
- Fixed #300 Revival uniques no longer block invulnerable-bypassing damage, such as /kill Revival
- Fixed #299 Throwable uniques no longer duplicate when thrown in creative
- Fixed #303 Throwable uniques now return false early to enforce ownership when picking up
- Fixed #281 and #261 Unique weapons can now be retrieved from storage systems added by other mods

Config:
- Added config option to blacklist entities from ability targeting and damage (includes passive creatures by default)
- Added config option to adjust GUI element position/scale
- Added config option to adjust unique ability damage dealt to players
- Added config option to adjust weapon hit damage dealt by non-players
- Added config option to disable modern visual effects
- Added config option to add gem sockets to any modded/vanilla weapon

response.name: NeoForge 1.61.3-1.21.1
response.changelog:
Changes:


- Oracle Index is no longer a mandatory dependency
- Tooltip CTRL hotkey will now attempt to open Oracle Index, REI, or EMI (in that order). If none are available, a error message will display instead
- Dynamic tooltips added to additional items

Note: You may experience issues withdrawing unique weapons from some modded storage systems, such as Create or RS2. This is down to an incompatibility between NeoForge and Architectury on Minecraft 1.21.1 and likely cannot be fixed until the mod is updated to run on a newer version of Minecraft.

response.name: FABRIC 1.60.9-1.21.1
response.changelog:
**Thank you:**
A huge thank you to Fzzyhmstrs for thier assistance in porting over features to 1.21.1, and to RosemaryThyme, Witherbomb47, and the rest of the testers over on the Simply Swords discord!

**Changes:**

Bugfixes:

- Fixed a bug that caused Soulstealer not to lose durability when breaking a block
- Fixed Null Pointer crash caused by Longsword of the Plague
- Fixed an issue that resulted in item frames being broken in one hit (Thanks RosemaryThyme!)
- Twinblades now display correctly in the offhand (Thanks RosemaryThyme)
- Lichblade may no longer be used in the offhand (Thanks RosemaryThyme)
- Storm's Edge, Hearthflame, and all three halberds now work correctly in the offhand (Thanks RosemaryThyme)




Additions:

- Added Iron's Spellbooks compat (Thanks DestrSpirit!)
- Added a recipe to smelt down runefused/netherfused gems into empowered_remnants (Allowing re-rolling gem abilities at a cost). Removed the old reroll recipe for runefused gems.
- Added contextual tooltip buttons for items (Ctrl & Alt)
- Added in-game documentation via Oracle Index (Replaces Patchouli)
- Added support for OpenPAC (alternative to vanilla /team)
- Spears are now throwable & can be enchanted with Loyalty (Other trident enchants can be applied, but they do not function at this stage)
- Added runic power 'Throwing' (not obtainable on runic spears)
- Added unique weapon 'Wraithfang'
- Added visual and sound effects to the Smouldering effect




Misc:

- Increased Lichblade ability damage from 4 to 6.
- Increased unique loot drop rate
- Increased the speed at which Contained Remnants transform
- Upgradeable unique weapons now retain their data when upgraded (Thanks RosemaryThyme!)
- Momentum can now used while airborne
- Advancements can now be translated via lang file (Thanks RosemaryThyme!)
- Unique weapons have been removed from spell casting blocklist (Spell Engine)
- Adjusted loot config to use 1-100 scale, instead of 0-1
- Soulrender slight rework (now a medium range weapon with Better Combat)
- Livyatan completely reworked
- Magispear can now be thrown
- Wickpiercer can now be thrown
- Sword on a Stick can now be thrown
- Wickpiercer ability slightly reworked
- Frostfall completely reworked
- Soulpyre reworked & retextured


**This is a config breaking update. The config system has been replaced and will not recognise your old config settings.**
